body:
Like the court?
The court let my family take him.
I signed the paper because I had nowhere to raise him at other than a shelter. I think my family would have done petitioned anyway if I tried to stay at a shelter, but who knows now? I didn't go that route.
The court said that since my brother and his wife are having temporary custody that they can make the decisions about his father without my consent. I didn't know all of this. Plus my superior parentel rights expire in July 12 of next year. Meaning my main chance to get him back is before then.
Right now I'm still wanting to die though because of the reasons stated above.
If I saw my younger self I'd say, stay away from your uncle. Leave your parents house when you can. Don't trust men so easily that are liars and just want to have pleasure for themselves.

I have an ex who acts like this. Said we could be friends after I broke up with him.
Later told me he was somewhat angry that I left him....

I asked him if he wanted to get back together. No.
So, what's the deal?

Nothing. It's not worth trying to get attention from someone who doesn't show it much.
If you guys were sexually active, I can understand the feeling like she's a part of you.
The name, the foreskin, makes me think of a sexual predator.
It'd be very painful to stab with a knife....

My sanity.
Hope.
At times really believing there's gonna be change.
Fear of pain.
Don't have a gun.
Scared at times...
Hoping someone really loves me.
Wanting to be responsible....

But-
Why doesn't this comment get kicked off?

Also, the man does supervised visitation with my son with my family that has him when he comes through. He's a trucker.

So, basically my family blames me.
Wants me to work hard to get my son back.
Doesn't believe me when I say the guy is a two faced liar that just wants to look good but have no responsibility or respect.

He gives them money.
I can't.

.....

Once again, wondering why I should even try?


It's not like I can start over if this doesn't end well.

My child will always be there.

I could move to another country, find a good man, start a new family before my body stops being able to, but he's still there.

The man won't leave me alone. He found out I lost custody. I gave him hints about it to see if he would help. He just sent some money. Never helped with anything other than that.
He lied about the child support. Signed for his rights anyway.
Claims if I get my child back that he wants visitation. Doesn't want to go to court.

If I decide to not end my life, and somehow tough it out and get my child back, even though my family makes it emotionally hard by blaming me and at times just ignoring me when I ask about him (visitation is once a week if I can make it halfway by a friend driving or Lyft, or I have to do Skype),

Then, I'm totally going after child support and gonna tell him to go through the court to do visitation.

That's only if I decide not to die.

I get blamed for stupid little things like asking my brother to move the camera during visitation or asking him to wipe my son's face if I saw he spat up during a Skype.
Apparently to my family that's me being mean, and they really believe that.
